steps: Issuer signs tokens with a key identified by kid.
JWKS endpoint publishes current and overlapping public keys.
Validator refreshes safely when a key is unknown or cache ages.
Matching public key verifies the token without exposing private material.

lesson.scenario: A resource server refreshes public signing keys safely when it sees an unfamiliar key ID.

steps.title: Cache the known key set
steps.narration: The cache stores acct-2026a, kty=RSA, use=sig, alg=RS256 for issuer https://accounts.example with max-age=300.
